svg.title: Breeding literature data pipeline
svg.desc: A shared versioned contract governs PDF extraction and legacy, omics and merged imports. Extraction parses pages, prepares an agent brief, produces candidates, repairs structure, verifies evidence, builds linked atomic records and validates records and datasets. Accepted JSONL carries explicit statements and entity anchors and feeds tables, a knowledge graph, an annotated corpus, QA seeds and document bundles. Rejections and audit reports support manual review and iteration. OCR text is supplied externally; natural-language QA generation is downstream.
svg.text: From papers to traceable atomic data
Contract-driven extraction, evidence checks and auditable outputs
Compile schemas, freeze and hash releases
Keep old versions; pin each record version
Load version, profile and filling rules
Candidate schema and pinned run version
Default agent mode: prepare → candidates.json → finalize
Keep reasons and candidates; review manually, revise, then rerun.
JSONL: one fact, observation, method or asset per line
Stable IDs, source locators, version and review status
Passing structural checks can still require human review.
Input hashes, versions and lineage support reruns.
Field function tags · multiple labels allowed
Solid: data processing and outputs Dashed: rejections and manual feedback Natural-language QA and OCR are external.
